description: Step 2 of the create_document_upload_url flow: call this AFTER your shell has PUT the file to the upload_url. Confirms the object actually landed in storage, backfills its real file_size/mime_type, and (unless analyze:false) runs AI analysis the same way upload_document does. Required: document_id (from create_document_upload_url). Throws a clear error if the upload hasn't landed yet — retry after confirming the PUT succeeded. Returns { document_id, storage_path, mime_type, file_size, analyzed, description? }.

analyze.description: Run AI text-extraction + summary after confirming the upload (default true).

name: finalize_document_upload
